title: Peloponnesian War
summary: Athens and Sparta fight a generation-long war that breaks the classical Greek balance.
body: Thucydides’ history made the conflict a school for later realists. Plague, Sicily, and oligarchic coups matter as much as set-piece battles. Editorial draft for this timeline, not a substitute for specialist literature.

sources.name: Thucydides, History of the Peloponnesian War
